Text: I think... I want to be forgiven
How many sleepless nights must we count
How many lives must be lost
Before the fighting comes to an end?
The answer is blowin' in the wind
How many times must our turned-away faces be struck
Before we stop pretending not to notice?
How much suffering must we endure
Before a smile can be free?
If we run away with our tails between our legs again
The answer is blowin' in the wind
With a voice strained to its limit
Destiny is surely waiting for its time to change
With the modest power of a tiny love
